title: Personalized Fitness & Health Tracking Platform
summary: Cloud-based platform that collects user activity and health data from mobile apps and wearables, generates personalized workout and wellness recommendations, tracks progress, and provides insights via dashboards.
features:
- Continuous activity and biometrics ingestion
- Personalization engine for workouts and nutrition
- Progress tracking and historical analytics
- Secure user identity and data encryption
- Dashboard insights and alerts
pain_point: Users lack continuous personalized guidance and consolidated health insights; providers lack scalable analytics to support personalization.
justification: Growing consumer demand for personalized health experiences and provider need for scalable analytics and compliance-ready data handling.
architecture_description: Mobile and web clients upload activity and health metrics via API Gateway to ingestion layer (Kinesis/S3). Real-time and batch pipelines process data into analytics stores; ML models in SageMaker/Personalize generate recommendations; dashboards via QuickSight; identity via Cognito.
phase_descriptions: Discovery, architecture, compliance scoping, and data contract definition.
Build ingestion, storage, and core infrastructure; enable identity and security.
Develop ML models, personalization engine, APIs, dashboards, and integration.
Testing, performance tuning, documentation, and handover to operations.
